SELECT 'fact' src, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT exposure_id) ex, count(DISTINCT member_key) mk, sum(delivered::int) deliv, min(contact_ts_utc) mn, max(contact_ts_utc) mx FROM fact_campaign_exposure WHERE campaign_id=19
UNION ALL SELECT 'stg', count(*), count(DISTINCT exposure_id), count(DISTINCT member_key), sum(delivered::int), min(contact_ts_utc), max(contact_ts_utc) FROM stg_campaign_contact_load WHERE campaign_id=19
UNION ALL SELECT 'holdout', count(*), count(DISTINCT member_id), 0,0,NULL,NULL FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19

SELECT contact_channel, delivered, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT e.member_key) mk, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) members, min(contact_ts_utc), max(contact_ts_utc) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e LEFT JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE campaign_id=19 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH c AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
d AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE e.campaign_id=19 AND e.delivered),
h AS (SELECT DISTINCT member_id FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM c) contacted, (SELECT count(*) FROM d) delivered_members, (SELECT count(*) FROM c JOIN h USING(member_id)) in_holdout, (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e WHERE campaign_id=19 AND member_key NOT IN (SELECT member_key FROM dim_member)) orphan_rows

calls.statement:
WITH c AS (SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE e.campaign_id=19),
s AS (SELECT m.member_id, f.* FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'),
r AS (SELECT m.member_id, rl.* FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN dim_member m USING(member_key) WHERE rl.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24')
SELECT (SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM s WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM c)) all_net,
(SELECT sum(net_amount) FROM s WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM c) AND NOT staff_purchase_flag) nonstaff_net,
(SELECT sum(gross_amount) FROM s WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM c)) all_gross,
(SELECT sum(refund_net) FROM r WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM c)) ret_net_bydate,
(SELECT sum(rl.refund_net) FROM fact_return_line rl JOIN s ON s.sales_line_id=rl.sales_line_id WHERE s.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM c)) ret_of_those_lines,
(SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM s WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM c)) buyers,
(SELECT sum(staff_purchase_flag::int) FROM s WHERE member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM c)) staff_lines

SELECT 'stg' t, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) d, min(sale_date) mn, max(sale_date) mx, sum(CASE WHEN sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) in_fact FROM stg_sales_line_load
UNION ALL SELECT 'fact_daily', count(*), count(DISTINCT sale_date), min(sale_date), max(sale_date), 0 FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
UNION ALL SELECT 'stgret', count(*), 0, min(return_date), max(return_date), sum(CASE WHEN return_line_id IN (SELECT return_line_id FROM fact_return_line) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM stg_return_line_load

SELECT sale_date, count(*) n, sum(net_amount) net, count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) loads, min(etl_loaded_at) l FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-02' AND DATE '2026-05-26' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH contacted AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
  FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
  WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
),
purchases AS (
  SELECT sum(f.net_amount) AS net_purchases
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = f.member_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
    AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted)
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT coalesce(sum(r.refund_net), 0) AS net_refunds
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = r.member_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
    AND m.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM contacted)
)
SELECT 19 AS campaign_id, 'Spring Garden Launch 2026' AS campaign_name,
       (SELECT count(*) FROM contacted) AS members_contacted,
       round((SELECT net_purchases FROM purchases) - (SELECT net_refunds FROM refunds), 2) AS net_spend_eur_ex_vat
